steps.title: Initialize PDF Creator Pro Project
steps.description: Setup core project files, establish target directories and configure package structure for com.pdfcreatorpro.app.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build Script
steps.description: Configure compile SDK to 34, target SDK to 34, and setup AGP 8.3.2 dependencies with Java 8 source compatibility rules.

steps.title: Configure Android Manifest Properties
steps.description: Set package identifier, permissions, Material default theme, and define launch activity orientations with system icon bindings.

steps.title: Create App Metadata Manifest
steps.description: Write global meta definition file app-meta.json mapping the project variables for app_name and package_name.

steps.title: Design Layout for Editor and PDF Listing
steps.description: Craft user interface featuring input forms for PDF parameters (title, author, content body) and an interactive container listing generated documents.

steps.title: Initialize MainActivity Logic
steps.description: Set up class structure, declare view bindings, instantiate directory references, and bypass StrictMode file exposure rules for native PDF rendering & sharing.

steps.title: Implement PDF Document Engine
steps.description: Develop native android.graphics.pdf.PdfDocument rendering flow with robust word-wrapping, multi-line paragraph generation, and custom margin formatting.

steps.title: Implement Document List Management
steps.description: Implement asynchronous local directory scanning to populate dynamically generated card rows showing PDF files, metadata, and controls.

steps.title: Implement Native Viewer and Document Sharing Intents
steps.description: Program secure Intent dispatchers to view generated PDFs instantly in external system PDF viewers or distribute documents to email and chat clients.

steps.title: Building PDF Creator Pro
steps.description: Initiate automated build compiling Java assets, optimization of resource XML sheets, and construction of standard debug outputs.
